attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

xy0-1.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

xy0-2.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

xy0-3.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

xy0-4.flavorText: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

xy0-5.flavorText: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

xy0-6.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

xy0-7.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

xy0-8.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy0-9.flavorText: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

xy0-10.flavorText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

xy0-11.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

xy0-12.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

attacks.name: Aqua Wave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

xy0-13.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

attacks.name: Mat Block
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

xy0-14.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

xy0-15.flavorText: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

xy0-16.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

attacks.name: Hard Bite
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy0-17.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

xy0-18.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

xy0-19.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

attacks.name: Wicked Jab
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

xy0-20.flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

attacks.name: Continuous Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

xy0-21.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

xy0-22.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

xy0-23.flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

xy0-24.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

xy0-25.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

xy0-26.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy0-27.flavorText: If it is around babies, it milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

xy0-28.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

xy0-29.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

xy0-30.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

xy0-31.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

xy0-32.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

xy0-33.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).
